algorithm: LightGBM gradient-boosted trees (57 trees); probability mapped to a 0–10 percentile score

training_data.name: NOAA Storm Events (FL, GA, AL), events within 25 miles of a site
Open-Meteo historical daily weather per site

label: A hazardous NOAA Storm Event (storm, flood, heat, wildfire, high wind) within 25 miles of the site that day
calibration_note: Calibration checked on 2023–2024 (reports/calibration_both.png). The app shows a percentile score, not a raw probability.
limitations: Labels come from reported storm events; unreported hazards count as calm days.
Heat events are rarely reported in Florida, so heat risk is also checked by a rule-based heat index.
Zone-wide events (e.g. heat) are matched to sites by county name.
Live lightning, flood warnings and active fires are applied by rules on top of the model score.
